mind-poisoning.name: mind_poisoning
mind-poisoning.description: BETA CANDIDATE 0.1.30: identity-checked gossip and reflection can influence CHIM opinions. Optional default-off intimacy recognition stores an NPC's own report separately; recognized child signals suppress only that arrangement lane, not ordinary opinions. Missing optional metadata is not evidence of adulthood; this is not universal age verification or mutual agreement. Written-evidence API v1 keeps its signatures and decoded-body limits while bounding raw envelopes at 65,536 bytes. The release fixes canonical sender identity, optional overhearing fallback, transaction isolation, operation-scoped logs, fenced JSON parsing, connector validation, and dashboard Host, search, and tail handling. Focused source and disposable-database checks passed. Real-model interpretation, installed behavior and gameplay remain unverified. Standard release classification supports discovery without promoting maturity.
